title: Integral tensor square after target tensorator cancellation
statement: Fix l,D,C,T,U,g,E and the single-field integral normalization of lem-sf-adic-reindexing-tensor-integral. For every pair K,L of integral constructible objects at E, the displayed tensor square becomes an equality after postcomposition with the inverse of the target realization tensorator at the pulled-back pair. This is the representative normalization equation before the final cancellation; it retains the inverse tensorator explicitly.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15, printed pp. 61-62; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach, Lemma 7.9.
source.note: The explicit postcomposition is the cancellation stage in the fixed-field representative calculation.

proof.text: Choose flat-term K-flat representatives for K and L and expand the two finite normalization equations, the integral reindexing representative equation, and the signed cochain pullback tensor comparison. The pure-section and quotient-coordinate calculations identify the two composites after the target tensorator inverse is appended.

Descend the representative equality through the K-flat comparison isomorphisms, raw rationalization, and fixed-stage inclusion. The inverse target tensorator is kept in the equation, so no cancellation or arbitrary coefficient-stage enlargement is used in this node.

proof_origin.place: The fixed integral coefficient representative calculation preceding the final tensorator cancellation in Proposition 6.8.14.

theorem normalized_reindexing_tensor_integral_cancelled
    (C : FamilyCore l D) (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (h_integral_normalization :
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
          (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g)) :
    ∀ (K L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) U.base.left),
    let I := GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
      (l := l) (Ω := PadicAlgCl l) (Y := U.base.left) E
    let Q := sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l
      (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) U.base.left
    let M := I.obj (Q.obj K)
    let N := I.obj (Q.obj L)
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    ((derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map
        ((C.data U).tensor.tensor.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app
        ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left).obj (M, N)) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom M N).hom) ≫
        (C.data T).tensor.tensor.inv.app
          ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj M,
           (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N) =
    ((C.pullTensor T U g).tensor.hom.app
        ((ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj M,
         (ordinary l U.base.left (C.data U).realization).obj N) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
        ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app M) ((C.comparison T U g).inv.app N)) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.tensor.hom.app
        ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj M,
         (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N) ≫
      (C.data T).tensor.tensor.inv.app
        ((commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj M,
         (commonStageDerivedPullback l (PadicAlgCl l) g.hom).obj N))
